### Item 1 — what the user expresses and how the simulator behaves

- Target object: negotiable bill of lading AHLU2608261734; goal "to get that telex release done so the cargo can be collected" (request made 12 September).
- Authorisation: "content for the agent to carry out whatever the line itself has to record, and you will do any part that has to be done by your company when the agent tells you what it is"; never suggests a step.
- Conditional disclosures: phone +85232748105 and customer code AHL-HK-258931 when asked; booking AHLU26SHA274613 if asked; freight paid 12 September ref KBL-FRT-24418 only if asked; "never received any originals" and "clerk, Mr Leung, is at the line's Shanghai documentation counter this morning" only if asked about the originals; if told the bill must be issued first and its originals handed straight back, asks the agent to go ahead and has Mr Leung hand in exactly the originals named; accepts an issuance fee; on a telex fee, raises "contract customers did not pay for telex releases" and asks for a check against the contract, then accepts whatever answer; pays nothing during the call.
- User-owned execution only after hand-over.

### Item 6 — problem tree walked from the visible documents alone

Root P0: effect / charge the telex release (customer's ask). Dependency direction P2 -> P1 -> P0.

- P0 "telex release fee booked / request completed" — telex_release_fee_booking_16e8648e "Entry condition: The full set of originals in circulation has been surrendered at the origin office, so that the document is surrendered and [originals outstanding] is 0, before the telex release fee is booked ... Where this is unmet, the telex release fee is not booked."; also telex_release_e6906cee cl.4 and cl.7 and 8e4daa52. Query: status `approved` -> unmet; action = full-set surrender (P1).
  - P1 "full-set surrender at origin" — full_set_surrender_for_telex_fa207782 "Entry condition: ... the full set can be surrendered only after the document has been issued under the issuance rules and its originals put into circulation ... Where this is unmet, the surrender is not taken." Query: status approved, no ledger rows, outstanding 0 -> unmet; action = issuance (P2).
    - P2 "issue the approved document" — ab097299 cl.1/cl.3 conditions: booking departed (holds); prepaid freight charges due 0.00 (holds). No further unmet condition; P2 is actionable by the agent.
  - P1's own conditions after P2: shipper exact-name match (holds); telex request on file answered by the surrender (5bd876eb).
- Handling order: P2 issue (agent, 75.00, 3 originals) -> P1 surrender 3 of set 1 (user) -> P0 telex fee 55.00 (agent).

Observation: the P1 entry-condition sentence is printed as "The document has been issued under bol_ issuance and its originals put into circulation before the full set is surrendered", followed by "The reference in that clause is to the product's issuance rules"; the P0 entry-condition sentence contains "originals_ outstanding". Both are split internal identifiers; the meaning is still recoverable from the surrounding gloss. Unlike task 0, no runbook lays out this chain; the tree is walked only through the two entry-condition sections.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Support: each hop is a quoted entry-condition or clause plus a query return; replay executes the chain to the stated terminal state.
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - telex fee not charged (the caller's contract claim) — 6cbcbc34 cl.1 relief needs rank "at least the document tier's minimum"; 1629bbb1 Key Account = 4; cfd1feda Negotiable minimum 5; 257279f1 no discount.
  - telex fee 0.00 row — 257279f1 "when the amount is zero, nothing is booked" (not reached here).
  - issuance with 0 originals — dc5b0672 truth table (approved + on board -> tier figure).
  - surrender count from the caller or from the tier set size without issuance — 55416686 "never from the caller's own count" and "with no originals-issued entry the balance is zero".
  - prepaid hold / refusal — booking charges due 0.00 (the record, not the caller's payment reference, governs: ab097299 "freight terms and charges due from the booking record").
  - LOI release instead — letter_of_indemnity_release_32a38818 applies "when originals cannot be presented" at destination; the caller asks for a telex release and the shipper is at the origin counter.
  - waiting — nothing in the visible KB defers issuance or surrender once the conditions hold; the clerk is at the origin counter now.
- "Do only what the customer asked" (charge / record the telex release at once) excluded by 16e8648e entry condition and 8e4daa52 ("registration alone does not put the release into effect"); "surrender only" excluded by fa207782 entry condition (document must first be issued). The customer never mentions issuance; these clauses force it.

### Difference noted: the `find_dnd_free_time` read

GT step 8 reads the container's discharge record, with the necessity text "bol_cargo_release's discharge-date gate is structurally attached to every release fee row and must be evidenced before the telex fee is booked". In the source, `bol_cargo_release.loi_after_discharge` has `applies_to: [bol_release_fee_charged]`, the event type shared by telex and LOI release fees, but its condition text is LOI-only ("Release against a letter of indemnity is allowed only from ..."). The visible KB renders it LOI-only (letter_of_indemnity_release_32a38818 cl.3, 335a9769), which matches the condition text. So nothing visible motivates this read for a telex release. It is a read with no DB effect; the discharge date 2026-09-09 would also meet the Negotiable LOI minimum of 3 days (2026-09-12 <= 2026-09-14). No write, value or terminal state changes. Nature: a policy-side modelling artefact (an LOI-only gate attached to a shared event type). I report it but it does not change this skill's verdict. It would matter only if an evaluator scored read steps.
